segmentation: unchanged production payload lengths and frame counts
classifier: Stage13A log1p features, seed-13 per-workload 70/30 split, train-only standardization, nearest centroid
final_frame_ablation: replace only final forwarding frames with padded size 2048 and retain every frame count and nonfinal size
budget_rule: maximum median additional wire percentage among eight nonempty workloads

A_current.rationale: Exact measured Stage13B control; stochastic production bucket rule separately validated

B_power_two.rationale: Requested power-of-two counterfactual; 128-512 are wire-format feasible but below the current 768-byte privacy floor

C_coarse.rationale: Four round coarse buckets preserving the current 768-byte minimum; dominant 1400-byte payload fits 1536

D_random_upper.rationale: Fixed distribution before classification; candidate is clamped to the next or maximum feasible bucket

E_small_flatten.rationale: Baseline length histogram has 16/32/64/128/224/256-byte small frames and no 257-399-byte frames; only 710 of 351055 frames qualify

F_constant_max.rationale: Simulation-only upper bound for per-frame padding with frozen frame count
